description: This Java source file defines the SubscriptionActor class, which manages subscription commands and events within an Akka actor system, handling stream operations, timeouts, and message forwarding for a subscription mechanism.

classes.name: SubscriptionActor
classes.description: An Akka actor that manages subscription commands, handles stream events, manages timeouts, and transitions to zombie state after completion or failure.

classes.name: SubscriberOps
classes.description: A private static class implementing Reactive Streams Subscriber<JsonArray> to forward stream events to the SubscriptionActor.

methods.name: props
methods.description: Creates Props for SubscriptionActor with specified idle timeout, sender, and headers.

methods.name: asSubscriber
methods.description: Wraps an ActorRef as a Reactive Streams Subscriber<JsonArray>.

methods.name: postStop
methods.description: Cleans up by cancelling the subscription if active when actor stops.

methods.name: createReceive
methods.description: Defines message handling for various subscription-related messages and timeouts.

methods.name: createZombieBehavior
methods.description: Defines behavior for zombie state where no further processing occurs.

methods.name: idleTimeout
methods.description: Handles actor timeout, reports failure, and transitions to zombie state.

methods.name: onSubscribe
methods.description: Handles subscription establishment, cancels previous if any, and unstashes messages.

methods.name: getSubscriptionCreated
methods.description: Creates a SubscriptionCreated event with current subscription ID and headers.

methods.name: setSenderAndDittoHeaders
methods.description: Updates sender and headers based on received command.

methods.name: requestSubscription
methods.description: Processes a request for more data, stashing if subscription not yet established.

methods.name: cancelSubscription
methods.description: Cancels an active subscription or stashes the request if not yet established.

methods.name: subscriptionHasNext
methods.description: Forwards a 'has next page' event to the sender.

methods.name: subscriptionComplete
methods.description: Handles completion of subscription, forwarding event and transitioning to zombie.

methods.name: subscriptionFailed
methods.description: Handles subscription failure, forwarding event and transitioning to zombie.

methods.name: becomeZombie
methods.description: Transitions actor to zombie state, stopping message processing after a delay.

methods.name: getSubscriptionId
methods.description: Returns the actor's name as the subscription ID.
